title: Clear a divisible first row without changing the trailing block
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, m a natural number, and H a matrix indexed by Fin (m + 1) in both directions over R. Suppose H(i.succ,0) = 0 for every i : Fin m and H(0,0) divides H(0,j.succ) for every j : Fin m. There exists a matrix V of the same size, invertible under matrix multiplication, such that HV has entry H(0,0) at (0,0), zero at (0,j.succ) and (i.succ,0), and entry H(i.succ,j.succ) at (i.succ,j.succ).
lean_statement: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (m : ℕ) (H : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) R), (∀ i : Fin m, H i.succ 0 = 0) → (∀ j : Fin m, H 0 0 ∣ H 0 j.succ) → ∃ V : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) R, IsUnit V ∧ H * V = Matrix.of (fun i j => Fin.cases (Fin.cases (H 0 0) (fun _ => 0) j) (fun i' => Fin.cases 0 (fun j' => H i'.succ j'.succ) j) i)
